deployment.note: Live USB cam + dual radar + mic (streams follow --mode).

buffer_memory_estimate.note: input window buffers only (not full activation peak)

key_meanings.weight_memory: Parameter + registered buffer memory footprint of the model in RAM/VRAM.
key_meanings.buffer_memory_estimate: Approximate input-window buffer footprint for deployment, not peak activations.
key_meanings.operation_specs: Per-block theoretical operation breakdown for the primary mode.
key_meanings.profiles: Per-mode results: both (cam+radar[+audio]), radar_only, camera_only, and audio_* ablations when the ckpt has audio.
key_meanings.total_macs: Total multiply-accumulate operations for one forward pass.
key_meanings.total_mops: Total MACs divided by 1e6. Despite the name, this is a count per inference, not per second.
key_meanings.total_flops: Total floating-point operations for one forward pass, using FLOPs = 2 * MACs.
key_meanings.total_gflops: Total FLOPs divided by 1e9 for one forward pass.
key_meanings.latency_ms_mean: Average forward-pass latency in milliseconds over measured runs.
key_meanings.throughput_fps: Approximate inferences per second, computed as 1000 / mean latency_ms.
key_meanings.achieved_mops_per_s: Theoretical MAC count divided by measured mean latency; effective achieved throughput in MOPS/s.
key_meanings.achieved_gflops_per_s: Theoretical FLOP count divided by measured mean latency; effective achieved throughput in GFLOPs/s.
key_meanings.conv_share: Fraction of total theoretical compute spent in convolution layers.
key_meanings.conv_mmacs: Millions of MACs spent in convolution layers.
key_meanings.temporal_transformer_mmacs: Millions of MACs spent in temporal self-attention + feed-forward blocks.
key_meanings.cross_attention_mmacs: Millions of MACs spent in radar-camera-audio cross-attention blocks.
key_meanings.mmacs_per_inference: Total millions of MACs for one forward pass.
key_meanings.gflops_per_inference: Total billions of FLOPs for one forward pass.
key_meanings.kpi.pass: Boolean pass/fail results against the AI-DISCO deployment thresholds.
